bib.title: LLEMMA: An Open Language Model for Mathematics

question: Can continued pretraining of Code Llama on a large open mixture of mathematical text and code yield an open base model that matches or beats closed domain models such as Minerva on mathematics?
hypothesis: Continued pretraining on Proof-Pile-2 improves a pretrained model's few-shot mathematical problem solving, tool use and formal theorem proving.
contributions: Train and release LLEMMA 7B and 34B, new state of the art for public base models on MATH
Release AlgebraicStack, 11B tokens of mathematical code
Demonstrate tool use (Python interpreter) and formal theorem provers
Open access models, data and code as a research platform

method.summary: Continue pretraining Code Llama 7B/34B with the autoregressive objective on Proof-Pile-2 (55B tokens of arXiv, OpenWebMath and AlgebraicStack) mixed with 5% general data, for 200B (7B) and 50B (34B) tokens. Evaluate few-shot on chain-of-thought maths, tool use and formal proving.

datasets.name: Proof-Pile-2
datasets.source: AlgebraicStack 11B + OpenWebMath 15B + ArXiv (RedPajama) 29B; cutoff April 2023 except Lean proofsteps
datasets.preprocessing: AlgebraicStack filtered by keyword whitelists, filesize < 1048575 bytes, numerical density 0.5, exact dedup on 2048-char chunks; Stack v1.2 near-deduplicated

datasets.name: General mix (Pile without ArXiv, RedPajama GitHub)
SAT (May 2023)
datasets.source: College Board May 2023 exam, built by authors

datasets.name: MetaMathQA
datasets.source: Yu et al. 2023, used for preliminary SFT (Appendix G)

other.note: scores quoted from Lewkowycz et al. 2022

models.name: Code Llama 7B/34B
models.init_from: Llama 2, trained on 500B tokens of code

training.lr_schedule: cosine decay to 1/30th of peak (7B scheduler length 48,000 steps; 34B decayed to 1/30th peak)
training.regularisation: general-domain data (5% of mixture) as regularization
training.hardware: 256 A100 40GB GPUs; GPT-NeoX; tensor parallel 2 (7B) or 8 (34B); ZeRO Stage 1; Flash Attention 2

other.mixture: 95% Proof-Pile-2, 2% Pile (no ArXiv), 3% RedPajama GitHub; arXiv:web:code ratio 2:4:1 chosen by short runs minimizing MATH training-set perplexity
other.weights_table8: AlgebraicStack 1.00, OpenWebMath 4.00, ArXiv 2.00, RedPajama code 0.22, Pile 0.15
other.sft_appendix_G: LLEMMA 7B finetuned on MetaMathQA with hyperparameters identical to Yu et al. 2023 (not listed)

inference.decoding: greedy for Table 1, Table 4 informal-to-formal; majority voting uses nucleus sampling; Lean uses beam search for tactics
inference.samples: maj@k: k=256 MATH, k=100 GSM8k and OCW, k=16 MMLU-STEM and SAT; Lean best-first search N=1, S=32, T=100
inference.prompting: MATH 4-shot (Minerva prompt), GSM8k 8-shot (Wei et al.), OCW 4-shot, MMLU-STEM 4-shot CoT, Isabelle 11 examples (7 for number theory, 6 others), Lean 3 examples

metrics.name: accuracy (greedy)
metrics.definition: exact string match or SymPy equivalence against reference answer

metrics.name: maj@k
metrics.definition: majority vote over k sampled solutions

metrics.name: pass@1 (tool use)
metrics.definition: fraction solved with Python program execution

metrics.name: proved theorems
metrics.definition: percentage of miniF2F theorems proven and checked by proof assistant

eval.protocol: Single greedy run; majority voting for sampled settings; Minerva numbers quoted from the Minerva paper; no seeds or significance tests stated.

prompts.text:
"""Given the Lean 4 tactic state, suggest a next tactic.
Here are some examples: ... (three tactic state / next tactic pairs) ... Tactic state:
---
%s
---
Next tactic:
---"""

limits: No from-scratch comparison; gains are over the Code Llama initialization
Mixture weights tuned on MATH training-set perplexity, using in-domain data for a hyperparameter
Could not check that contracting RoPE base period for 34B has no penalty
7B run stopped at 42,000 of 48,000 planned steps after NaN losses
Memorization analysis is a lower bound (exact n-gram match only)
Minerva scores quoted not re-run; no majority-vote scores for Llama 2 and Code Llama due to compute
SFT study is preliminary; no seeds or significance tests
